statement_fidelity.mathdb_statement: PD^TAR(K_{s,t}) is unique if and only if s != 2 and t != 2.
statement_fidelity.source: arXiv:2201.01798 v1 (2022-01-05), Conjecture labelled conj after Prop p:K33 (3.24 arXiv); journal version La Matematica 5 (2026) art. 8, doi 10.1007/s44007-025-00187-5, Conjecture 3.25 per search-engine excerpt (publisher page not directly accessible)

definitions.power_domination: source P^0=S, P^1=N[S], P^i adds unique unobserved neighbours of observed vertices; PD iff P^i[S]=V for some i
definitions.TAR_graph: vertices = all PD sets; S1~S2 iff |S1 symdiff S2| = 1 (PD^TAR = PD^TAR_n)
definitions.unique: for G without isolated vertices: for all H without isolated vertices, PD^TAR(G) ~= PD^TAR(H) implies H ~= G (source sec. 3.3, verbatim)
definitions.range: s,t positive integers (K_{s,0} has isolated vertices, outside the definition); graphs finite simple; no connectedness or order assumption on H

reduction.theorem: Bong, Carlson, Curtis, Haas, Hogben, Graphs Combin. 39 (2023) no. 86, Thm 1.1 = survey arXiv:2406.05509v2 Thm t:main
reduction.hypotheses: robust X-set parameter (power domination is an original hence robust parameter, stated in survey); both graphs without isolated vertices (exactly the uniqueness definition's hypothesis)
reduction.conclusion: a relabeling (vertex bijection, so equal orders) under which G and H have exactly the same PD sets
reduction.applies_to_arbitrary_H: yes: H only needs no isolated vertices; vertex count is derived (also source Cor c:pd-iso-props); no extra argument needed
reduction.core_equivalence: for s,t>=3, (s,t)!=(3,3): uniqueness <=> every graph H on A u B with PD(H)=PD(K_{A,B}) equals K_{A,B} (converse direction trivial)

full_conjecture_cases.K_{1,2}=P_3: not unique: P_3 and K_3 both have every nonempty set PD (trivial, written in PROOF.md sec. 7)
full_conjecture_cases.K_{1,1}: unique (order = max degree of TAR graph = 2)

lemmas.statement: S PD <=> every fort meets N[S] (source round definition)
every fort F of H: (A in N[F] and |N[F]&B|>=2) or (B in N[F] and |N[F]&A|>=2); H has no isolated vertex
lemmas.uses: PD sets of K are PD in H

lemmas.statement: pair forts: N[Psi_xy] = B u {x,y}, N[Phi_uv] = A u {u,v}
every vertex has a neighbour on the other side
no vertex is a leaf hanging on the other side
a cross-degree-1 vertex forces s=t=3 (hub structure = relabelled K_{3,3})
A-B complete => A, B independent => H = K_{A,B}
